name: How long do hardware and functional adjustments typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long do hardware and functional adjustments typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required depends on the scope of the adjustments needed. For a typical residential project, these adjustments can range from a few hours to a couple of days. A more extensive project with numerous custom components might require more time. We aim for efficiency while ensuring thoroughness in our work.
acceptedAnswer.description: The duration varies based on the scope, typically ranging from a few hours to a couple of days for residential projects.
